preconditions.description: The number of junctions (n) and roads (m) must be within the given bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct junctions within the valid range.
No duplicate roads exist between the same pair of junctions.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by exactly three routes.

postconditions.expression: all(len(route) >= 3 for route in routes) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: Each route must have at least 3 junctions (start, at least one intermediate, and finish).

postconditions.expression: all(routes[0][0] == routes[1][0] == routes[2][0] and routes[0][-1] == routes[1][-1] == routes[2][-1] for routes in [[routes[0], routes[1], routes[2]]]) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: All routes must start and end at the same junction, and the start and finish junctions must differ.

postconditions.expression: all(routes[0][0] != routes[0][-1] and routes[1][0] != routes[1][-1] and routes[2][0] != routes[2][-1]) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: The start and finish junctions of each route must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(route) - {route[0], route[-1]}) == len(route) - 2 for route in routes) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: No intermediate junction is visited more than once in any route.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set((route[i], route[i+1]) for i in range(len(route)-1))) == len(route) - 1 for route in routes) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: No road is traversed more than once in any route (regardless of direction).

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(route) & set(other_route) - {route[0], route[-1]}) == 0 for i in range(3) for other_route in [routes[(i+1)%3], routes[(i+2)%3]]) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: No two routes share any intermediate junction.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set((routes[i][j], routes[i][j+1]) for j in range(len(routes[i])-1)) & set((routes[k][l], routes[k][l+1]) for l in range(len(routes[k])-1))) == 0 for i in range(3) for k in range(i+1, 3)) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: No two routes traverse the same road in the same or opposite direction.
